task_instance: Prepare a batch of sample Firecrawl scrape documents (extracted JSON + markdown) for a RAG store: validate the envelope and provenance, normalize canonical URLs and compute content hashes for deduplication, detect prompt-injection/active content, validate extracted JSON against a declared schema, separate raw-quarantine / approved / embeddings / audit stores, and run a retention/deletion with disposal verification.
evidence: Skill is a local, file-only data-handling skill (allowed-tools Read/Glob/Grep/Write/Edit; it explicitly forbids calling Firecrawl when invoked), so no network or SDK was required. All skill files present (SKILL.md plus references/official-docs.md, the latter only a citations list with placeholder links). Created 6 realistic sample Firecrawl documents in input/ (one clean page, one byte-identical mirror, one 404 error page, one with no sourceURL, one carrying prompt-injection/script markup, one whose extracted price_usd is a string). Implemented pipeline.py (stdlib only, run with python3 -I) covering SKILL instructions 2-7: envelope+provenance+status validation, canonical-URL normalization (fragment dropped, utm_* query params stripped), sha256 content hashing + dedup, injection detection (regex for 'ignore previous instructions', 'disregard system prompt', <script>, system:/assistant:, export api key), declared-schema validation (plan:str, price_usd:number, billing in {monthly,yearly}), and store separation into stores/raw_quarantine, stores/approved, stores/embeddings, stores/audit. Run output counts: total 6, approved 1, rejected 2 (404 error page; missing provenance), quarantined_review 2 (injection doc; bad schema type), deduped 1 (identical content hash to the approved doc). Deliverables verified on disk: inventory_report.json (full per-doc decisions, reasons, provenance, hashes, schema and retention policy), stores/audit/receipts.jsonl, and the four store directories populated as expected. Retention/deletion step: deleted the one approved record by content hash from both approved and embeddings derived stores, appended a tombstone to stores/audit/tombstones.jsonl, and verified disposal programmatically (assert 0 surviving copies of the target hash across derived stores) plus a before/after file listing showing the approved and embedding files gone. The provenance-preserving, injection-aware normalization path and its disposal evidence are the skill's stated core deliverable and both really exist and were verified.
